To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
corticosterone levels influence the timing and duration of the infant rat sensitive-period learning.
corticosterone modulates the sensitive period by influencing olfactory bulb neural activity and odor learning in the infant rat.

(a) CORT levels modulate the sensitive-period odor-shocks-induced preferences, (b) CORT replacement in adrenalectomized animals reinstates fear learning, and (c) the olfactory bulb correlates sensitive-period odor learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of corticosterone in the modulation of the sensitive-period learning in infant rats.
the role of the endogenous corticosteroids in the modulation of the sensitive period of learning and the underlying mechanisms.
the neuroendocrine mechanisms underlying the development of sensitive-period learning and how these mechanisms may be disrupted by stress.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CORT is necessary and sufficient for the expression of odor learning during the sensitive period and that the CORT system is a key regulator of the expression of sensitive-period learning.
corticosterone influences sensitive-period learning by modulating olfactory bulb activity and behavior.
CORT is a critical factor in the regulation of sensitive-period learning in infant rats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CORT plays an important role in the modulation of odor-shock-induced learning during a neonatal sensitive period.
CORT is an essential modulator of the neonatal sensitive-period olfactory learning.
the endogenous corticosteroid level during the sensitive period is a critical factor for the acquisition of odor-shock-induced learning in infant rats.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the endocrine system modulates sensitive-period learning, and that CORT is a key regulator of the sensitive period.
corticosterone levels are a critical modulator of the sensitive period.
corticosterone modulates the development of the sensitive period for odor learning and that this modulation occurs via the olfactory bulb.
